message:
feat: prepare 0.5.0 with configurable renderer sizing and inline SMILES

Add validated width, height and display attributes, global and per-renderer defaults, natural SMILES sizing and compact responsive molecular viewers. Document the API and update examples in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Fix TikZ fonts in Shadow DOM, WaveDrom styles, bundled MathJax glyphs, JSXGraph compatibility and UART/SPI timing examples. Preserve ABC layout and controls, correct the mmCIF fixture and bound production minification workers.

Validate 346 unit tests, 12 distribution tests, application types and 15 application integration tests.
